summary: Iteration 24: Brain Editor & Agent Collaboration Testing - All 10 tests PASSED. Brain Editor modal works correctly with all fields (Name, Role, Description, Personality & Tone, Expertise Areas, Do's, Don'ts, Knowledge Base, Model Provider, Model Name). Backend APIs for brain update and agent detail retrieval work correctly. Commander delegation returns comprehensive multi-agent response. Team navigation works across pages.

test_1_edit_brain_button.description: Expanded agent shows 'Edit Brain' button next to 'Delete' in Admin > Agents tab

test_2_brain_editor_modal.description: Brain Editor modal opens with all required fields: Name, Role, Description, Personality & Tone, Expertise Areas, Do's, Don'ts, Knowledge Base, Model Provider, Model Name

test_3_save_brain_ui.description: Brain Editor Save button works - form values are saved correctly as verified by subsequent modal opens showing saved data

test_4_backend_brain_update.description: PUT /api/admin/agents/{agent_id}/brain correctly saves personality_tone, expertise_areas, dos, donts fields and rebuilds system_prompt with '--- BRAIN CONFIG ---' section

test_5_backend_agent_detail.description: GET /api/admin/agents/{agent_id} returns full agent details including all brain fields

test_6_agent_collaboration.description: Agent collaboration infrastructure is in place. CLARIFICATION_INSTRUCTION includes [CONSULT:agent_id] syntax. Agents can reference SEO specialist (agent_seo) and other specialists when needed. LLM decides when to use CONSULT tags based on context.

test_7_team_nav_link.description: Team nav link visible and functional in sidebar across Dashboard, Settings, and Team pages

test_8_commander_delegation.description: Commander AI returns comprehensive multi-agent delegation response with delegation_data including task_count, agent assignments, and individual responses from specialists

test_10_cancel_button.description: Brain Editor Cancel button closes the modal without saving

critical_code_review_comments: Brain Editor implementation is complete and functional
All brain fields are correctly saved and retrieved
System prompt is properly rebuilt with BRAIN CONFIG section when brain fields are updated
Agent collaboration instruction with [CONSULT:] tag syntax is included in CLARIFICATION_INSTRUCTION
seed_data_creation: No new seed data - used existing admin account and agents
